subject.title: feat(browser): expand Chrome MCP web capabilities

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's expanded Chrome MCP Browser capability/config/security boundary as-is, split it, or narrow it before merge?
rationale: The PR intentionally exposes new browser debug, artifact, extension mutation, page-provided tool, WebMCP, config, and CI-policy surfaces; code review can find defects, but maintainers must decide the permanent authority boundary.

options.title: Gate On Owner Acceptance And Refresh
options.body: Require Browser/security owner acceptance, update the browser-control docs, resolve conflicts/check failures, and rerun relevant Browser/config/scripts validation before merge.

options.title: Split Automation Policy
options.body: Move the type-only import-cycle checker change into its own PR so Browser capability expansion and CI architecture enforcement can be reviewed independently.

options.title: Narrow The Capability Slice
options.body: Pause or reduce the PR to diagnostics-only if maintainers are not ready to accept extension mutation or page-provided tool execution.

recommendation.title: Gate On Owner Acceptance And Refresh
recommendation.body: Require Browser/security owner acceptance, update the browser-control docs, resolve conflicts/check failures, and rerun relevant Browser/config/scripts validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Browser docs/config and tooling history plus broad security/automation ownership signals make this the best available decision route from the evidence gathered.
